description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named TrackAdapter for displaying a list of Track objects. It manages items' view creation, binding, and handles item click events. It uses Data Binding for item views and DiffUtil for efficient list updates.

classes.name: TrackAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView ListAdapter for displaying Track objects with click handling.

classes.name: TrackAdapter.TrackViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that binds Track data to item view and handles item click events.

classes.name: TrackDiffCallback
classes.description: DiffUtil.ItemCallback implementation for optimizing list updates based on Track item differences.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new TrackViewHolder with inflated item view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the TrackViewHolder for the given position.

methods.name: TrackViewHolder.bind
methods.description: Binds a Track object's properties to the view components.
